tools.name: scan_code
tools.title: Scan code for vulnerabilities
tools.description: Run the SentinelOps Cybersecurity Agent over a source snippet and return findings, severities, CWE mappings and suggested patches.

source.description: Raw source code or configuration to audit.

filename.description: Optional filename used for context in the report, e.g. app.py.

tools.name: devops_heal
tools.title: Diagnose and heal a pipeline failure
tools.description: Run the SentinelOps DevOps Agent over a CI/CD or runtime failure log and return the root cause, remediation steps and an automated fix.

log.description: Raw CI/CD, container or Kubernetes failure log output.

tools.name: formal_verify
tools.title: Verify and sign an artifact
tools.description: Scan an artifact, run 5 heuristic obligation checks, and return a SHA-256 digest with an HMAC-SHA256 signature. Heuristic checks, not a formal proof.

source.description: Raw source code or configuration to verify.

artifactName.description: Optional artifact name recorded in the signed result.
